title: Reconnect an orphaned payload link
prompt: Repair starter/robot.json. The payload is present in the RobotDesignIR but is disconnected from the base-arm kinematic tree, so a compiler may silently omit it. Preserve all three links and the existing shoulder joint. Connect payload to arm with one fixed joint. The final robot must have exactly one root, every non-root link must have exactly one parent, every link must be reachable, every IR link must appear as a compiled MuJoCo body, and the MJCF must load. Do not create additional output files.
